finding_reviews.statement: A compact one-hour temperature predictor modestly improves persistence but does not outperform the residual kernel or identify thermoregulation.

mechanism.rationale: Internal thermal inertia is plausible; behavioral regulation, ambient forcing, sensor placement and observational timing are not separated causally.

novelty.rationale: Thermal response and autoregressive forecasting are known; no new bee-regulation mechanism established. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
